description.narrative: AzMina is a digital community led organisation driven by LBTQ people and women of color with a mission to promote gender equity through information, education and technology to address fundamental issues around race and ethnicity, social class and sexual orientation in Brazil and across South America. AzMina uses digital platforms including social media to raise awareness on the multiple forms of violence against women and girls and advocate for women's rights including racial justice, LBTQ rights and economic justice. The grant will support the following specific priorities and activities: - strengthen and expand the impact of PenhaS app - continue the legislative monitoring and improvement of political conditions for women (through "MonitorA" and "Elas no Congresso" projects) - Increase investment in AzMina's institutional strengthening - Investment in technology and security.
